name: Casas Altas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the arms of Casas Altas (three houses on red, a bird beneath a cross, and waves).
history: The official flag of Casas Altas is of proportions 2:3, party per fess, the upper stripe white and the lower red, with the arms occupying three fifths of the height of the flag; it was approved by resolution of 5 July 2017 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOGV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 21 March 2000.

features.role: Casas Altas arms — three houses on red, a bird beneath a cross on red, and waves on blue
